Title: Raptor and Nar-Sheptha hand size effect

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Question from the discord

If Vamp A with 1 Raptor block Vamp B with Nar-Sheptha, what happens? Does Vamp B gains +2 hand size, and then gets -1 hand size, having to discard? Or both effects resolve at the same time and Vamp B gets +1 hand size?

Raptor

Cardtype: Retainer
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Animalism
Animal with 1 life.
The minion with this retainer gets +1 intercept.
As above, and when the minion with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion's controller gets -1 hand size.

Nar-Sheptha

Cardtype: Retainer
Clan: Banu Haqim
Cost: 1 pool
Unique wraith with 1 life.
While this vampire is in combat, you get +2 hand size, and the opposing minion is considered the acting minion.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Both effects take place at the same time, so the vampire gets +2-1=+1 hand size.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: Could you please explain why ordering isn’t relevant here but is during the unlock phase when having eg a Vessel and an Anarch Revolt is in play?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> Could you please explain why ordering isn’t relevant here but is during the unlock phase when having eg a Vessel and an Anarch Revolt is in play?
>
Continuous effects that start at the same time are not ordered.

If you use a Vessel, you have to resolve the effect entirely before moving on (you can't "use" the Anarch Revolt at the same time), so you have to choose an order.
